fit-to-ride.name: Fit to ride
fit-to-ride.description: Whether a rider may ride and whether they should: license classes, permits, age limits, course waivers, registration and insurance, alcohol and blood alcohol limits, drugs, fatigue, emotional state, the penalties, and stepping in when someone else is impaired.

gear-and-bike-check.name: Riding gear & bike check
gear-and-bike-check.description: Everything settled before moving: helmets and the DOT standard, eye and face protection, jackets, boots, gloves, hearing protection and weather layering, the controls and the gear pattern, the pre-ride inspection, choosing a bike that fits, and borrowing an unfamiliar one.

basic-control.name: Basic control
basic-control.description: Body position, the friction zone, shifting, braking, turning, counter-steering and tight U-turns.

visibility-and-communication.name: Visibility & communication
visibility-and-communication.description: Being seen and saying what you intend: conspicuity, headlight, signals, brake light, horn, mirrors, head checks and blind spots.

space-management.name: Space management
space-management.description: Lane position, following distance, being followed too closely, passing, merging and riding in a group.

search-and-strategy.name: Search & strategy
search-and-strategy.description: Scanning ahead and deciding early: intersections, prioritizing hazards and keeping an escape route.

hazards-and-surfaces.name: Hazards & surfaces
hazards-and-surfaces.description: Slippery surfaces, obstacles, tracks and gratings, night riding, wind, animals, and what to do when the bike itself fails.

passengers-and-cargo.name: Passengers & cargo
passengers-and-cargo.description: Carrying a passenger and a load: instructions before the ride, the equipment required, where weight goes, and how both change the handling.

signs-and-markings.name: Signs & road markings
signs-and-markings.description: Sign shapes, colors and meanings, traffic signals, pavement markings, and what each one requires of a rider.

additional-information.name: Additional information
additional-information.description: Material a rider's own state tests that sits outside the topics above.
